_meta.description: Greenbone/GVM vulnerability findings -- one document per finding-per-host-per-port, upserted on a deterministic _id so reruns update first_seen/last_seen rather than duplicating. finding_id is the NVT OID (not always a CVE -- a real finding can have zero associated CVEs). Deliberately does NOT carry threat=Log rows -- those are filtered out in gvm_findings_sync.py before documents are ever built, not at ingest time, since real production data showed Log makes up ~90-95% of raw results (see docs/elasticsearch-stack/README.md section 3). See that doc for the full data model and the real, unresolved CVSS v2-vs-v3/threat-bucket cross-source severity caveat.
